abstract: Forty consecutive patients with far-advanced germinal testis tumors (lymph node metastases greater than 10 cm, pulmonary nodules greater than 5 cm, extrapulmonary spread, alpha-fetoprotein greater than 1000 ng/ml, human chorionic gonadotropin greater than 50,000 mIU/ml) were treated with five courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (PEB). Twenty-five patients underwent surgery for the removal of residual masses after the first three inductions. Fibrotic-necrotic tissue was resected in 11 cases, 12 had mature teratoma, and residual cancer was found in 2. After the combined-modality treatment, 37 patients (82.5%) entered complete remission (CR): 25 (62.5%) with PEB and 12 (30%) with PEB and complete removal of the residual tumor. One patient progressed on therapy, and two others had incomplete resection of the residual disease. Hematologic toxicity was moderate and gastrointestinal toxicity was very mild. After a median follow-up period of 24 months (range, 13-40), 33 patients (82.5%) remain continuously disease-free, and 4 experienced relapse. Only one of these was salvaged with further surgery and chemotherapy. First-line PEB therapy combined with early resection of residual tumor induced a very high continuous CR rate in patients with far-advanced germinal testis cancer, and toxicity was moderate.
abstract_ja: 高度進行期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍（リンパ節転移10cm超、肺結節5cm超、肺外進展、αフェトプロテイン1000ng/ml超、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン50,000mIU/ml超）の連続40例に、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン（PEB）による5コースの治療を行った。最初の3コース後に25例が残存腫瘤の除去手術を受けた。11例では線維壊死組織を切除し、12例では成熟奇形腫が、2例では残存癌が確認された。併用治療の結果、37例（82.5%）が完全寛解（CR）に至り、そのうち25例（62.5%）はPEBのみ、12例（30%）はPEBと残存腫瘍の完全切除により寛解した。1例は治療中に進行し、2例では残存病変の切除が不完全であった。血液毒性は中等度、消化管毒性はきわめて軽度であった。中央値24か月（範囲13〜40）の追跡後、33例（82.5%）が継続して無病であり、4例に再発がみられた。このうち1例のみが、追加の手術と化学療法により救済された。高度進行期の精巣がん患者において、初回のPEB療法と残存腫瘍の早期切除の併用は、非常に高い継続的CR率をもたらし、毒性も中等度であった。
